pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. The dinosaur is standing tall on its hind legs to utilize the 140px vertical height.
pose_constraints.orientation: The body faces the camera, but the neck is arched in a tight 'S-curve' so the snout points downward and slightly toward the center-frame.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Wide-angle, full-body shot from a medium distance. This ensures the entire snout, head, neck, and dorsal sail are within the 340px width.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The snout does not extend past the shoulders. By curving the neck, we keep the most horizontal feature (the snout) contained within the vertical silhouette of the body.
pose_constraints.framing_note: Ensure a 20px 'safe zone' of empty space on the left and right sides of the image to prevent any clipping of the snout or tail.

character_details.expression: Dignified and calm; the large eye is positioned at the top-center of the frame.
character_details.texture: Clean, high-end animated matte skin. Soft highlights on the snout and sail.
character_details.colors: Deep teal body. The dorsal sail is a contrasting burnt-sienna, and the snout has a matching amber glow.
features: Unmistakable long, slender crocodilian snout, fully visible and in-frame.
Clear dorsal ridge/sail peaking behind the curved neck.
Compact body profile to fit the horizontal constraint.

flora: Minimalist reeds on the far edges to frame the dinosaur.
environmental_details.lighting: Top-down cinematic sun, highlighting the top of the snout and the ridge of the sail simultaneously.
